# DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 on three DGX Spark systems

> Run abliterated DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 in EXL3 format at 3.84 bits per weight with TensorFold tensor parallelism 3 (TP3) on three NVIDIA DGX Spark GB10 systems.

Why it matters: uncensored DeepSeek V4.1 Flash on three small desktop machines, with 3,833 tok/s peak prefill, 126 tok/s single-stream code, 263 tok/s across 16 requests, 0 of 100 HarmBench prompts refused, 97.5% AIME 2025, 90.5% GPQA-Diamond, and the lowest KL to the official model of the 8 packs scored. Engine source, deploy scripts, API and raw benchmark data are all in this repository.

v1.2 (2026-11-04) is the active release. Engine 678ea1b runs 8M KV, C16, graph cap 128, R48, top_k 20, spill 256 GiB and prefill layer slices with serving API 0.1.5. Historical v1.1 (2026-11-02, the first public release) uses 14803a3. Historical v1 uses 7d5b4d8/10M; its October 30 speed suite used cebcf1e.

Prefill (v1.1, 2026-11-02, cold, one request): 3,560 tok/s at 4K, 3,833 at 32K, 3,721 at 128K; a 131,090-token prompt reads in 35.4 s.

Decode (v1.1): 126 tok/s single-stream code and 84 prose (greedy); 254 and 263 tok/s aggregate at 16 streams.

Fidelity: mean KL 0.0784 and 92.0% top-1 agreement against official DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 logits (65 cuts of 2,048 tokens), the lowest of every pack scored on the same panel, including an unedited 3.5 bpw EXL3 quant (0.0872). Refusals: 0 of 100 HarmBench prompts refused in chat (98 answered, 2 partial); 0 of 50 XSTest safe prompts refused. Quality: AIME 2025 97.5% (117 of 120, 4 repeats, thinking on); GPQA-Diamond 90.5% (1,434 of 1,584, 8 repeats, thinking on); IFEval 88.7% (prompt-level strict); LiveCodeBench v6 88.0%; MMLU-Pro 88.0% (500-item subset).

Text serving uses a 1,048,576-token context. The historical serving suite measures through 32K; the November 2 native prefill suite reaches 131,090 tokens. The 3.84 bpw value excludes the output head.

Repository code is Apache-2.0; third-party code keeps its own licenses. Weights: https://huggingface.co/ChimeraWerks/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017-EXL3-3.84bpw-abliterated
